{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1675uru",
      "toKey": "n-1ll2v21",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The condition that the air gallery serves RHOB (normal state) combined with a lack of authorized line opening at 10:02 suggests an interruption occurred within the system rather than via an intentional, authorized isolation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": ["claim-gyysd1"],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized, the interruption would be attributed to that action; since it was not authorized, an unrecorded or unauthorized mechanism is implied.",
      "competingExplanation": "An undetected upstream valve closure by another team without notification",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of who controlled valves in this zone and whether any change orders were issued between March 1 and May 20."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-6s8tyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop from ~6.8 bar to below 4.5 bar directly caused the shift log's inability to identify a specific interruption point, as the event was not logged with precision.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["claim-12ce684#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure drop had been gradual or logged with timestamps, the interruption point might be identifiable.",
      "competingExplanation": "The shift log operator simply failed to record details despite having access",
      "evidenceGap": "Need raw timestamped data from P-R sensor if available."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q7dwrs",
      "toKey": "n-1g2cait",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The blank temporary instruction field and unsigned acceptance signature enabled the scenario where normal pressure bands were operator entries rather than verified measurements, contributing to ambiguity.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": ["claim-gyysd1", "finding-1jzx7az"],
      "counterfactual": "If the temporary instruction field had been filled and signed, it would likely have included specific valve states or pressure expectations.",
      "competingExplanation": "The operator misread a normal entry as an actual measurement without verification",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to confirm if any verbal instructions were given regarding expected pressures."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "Three causal links are supported: (1) Normal service conditions combined with no authorized line opening imply an unrecorded interruption; (2) The pressure drop caused the shift log's lack of specific timing data; (3) Blank documentation enabled ambiguity between operator entries and actual measurements. Competing explanations include unauthorized valve closure or misinterpretation of normal bands.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "claim-gyysd1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Exact sequence of communication between RHOB and Utilities (q-isvv2m)", "Whether any change orders were issued for instrument-air service", "Raw timestamped data from P-R sensor if available"],
    "alternatives": [
      "Undetected upstream valve closure by another team without notification",
      "Operator misread a normal entry as an actual measurement"
    ],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": []
}
